headline: On 20 held-out seeds in simulated Indian mixed traffic, CHOWK reduced delay per person by 4.6% versus area max-pressure (95% CI −7.5% to −1.7%), with 60.0% lower delay versus Webster fixed-time (95% CI −62.7% to −57.2%). Simulation result.
